assertions.assert: On start it waits in `Unclassified` and sends nothing; it is long-lived: it never reaches a final state.

`bot.ability.vision.classification.input` `{kind: "text", content}` whose text is not blank is classified as text: it answers its parent with `bot.ability.vision.classification.output` `{kind: "text", confidence: 1.0}`.
An input `{kind: "image", content}` with a reference (non-empty content) is classified as image: `{kind: "image", confidence: 1.0}`; classifying reads nothing, so the reference need not name a file.
Anything else is unreadable: blank text or an image with an empty reference is answered `{kind: "unreadable", confidence: 1.0}`.
After answering it is back in `Unclassified`: every input is answered once, in order.
An input whose data does not satisfy its schema (`kind` other than text or image, or a missing `content`) is `error.execution` in its sender and is never classified.
